note: Villa partis for concept generation. Properties cite qualitative evidence cards; the generator uses the 'generator' block; the critic scores every variant the same way whatever its parti.

typologies.name: Linear bar
strengths: every room gets an exterior exposure
an east-west bar puts most glass on north and south
cautions: long circulation spine; privacy depends on where the spine runs
a long west end needs shading

typologies.name: L-shape
strengths: two wings separate public and private
the inside corner makes a sheltered garden
cautions: the corner room is dark and hard to plan
one wing may face east or west

typologies.name: U-shape / three-sided court
strengths: a shaded outdoor room in a hot-dry climate
cautions: the court must open to prevailing breeze and away from low sun

typologies.name: Courtyard (four-sided)
cautions: circulation around the court costs area
court proportion drives daylight and sun

typologies.name: Pavilion cluster
cautions: privacy only if links avoid the hosting route

typologies.name: Pinwheel
strengths: wings reach separate site features and views

typologies.name: Grid / modular block
strengths: structure, services and rooms share one module
cautions: risk of monotony; hierarchy must come from size and void
